expressions.title: The Supreme Court Judges (Oath of Office) Order, 1977
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Islamabad, September 22, 1977, p.517) prints No. F. 24(2)/77-Pub. and 'THE SUPREME COURT JUDGES (OATH OF OFFICE) ORDER, 1977, President's (Post-Proclamation) Order No. 9 of 1977', Articles 1-2 and the Schedule (oath), continued on p2 (p.518) to the signatures of the President, the Chief Martial Law Administrator and 'MIR MOHAMMAD ALI, Draftsman and Additional Secretary' (block 2339623).

expressions.title: The High Court Judges (Oath of Office) (Amendment) Order, 1977
expressions.title_basis: p2 blocks 2339624-2339627 print the notification and 'THE HIGH COURT JUDGES (OATH OF OFFICE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1977', P.P.O. No. 10 of 1977; Article 1 names it; complete; not held elsewhere in the corpus.
